title: Azure Synapse Pipelines Pipeline Run Duration p95
app: Azure Synapse pipeline diagnostics via Azure Monitor/Event Hub to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=azure:synapse:pipeline status="Succeeded"
| eval dur_min=round(duration_ms/60000,2)
| stats avg(dur_min) as avg_min, p95(dur_min) as p95_min, count as runs by pipeline_name
| where p95_min>30
| sort - p95_min
description: Computes the 95th-percentile run duration for each pipeline in Azure Synapse Pipelines and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Azure Synapse Pipelines pipelines by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Azure Synapse Pipelines timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest pipelines with their owners.
visualization: Table of pipeline by p95 run duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Azure Synapse Pipelines so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
